project: Ernestinho Carioca - Guía de Río, traducciones FR paralelas
content_policy: Do not rewrite approved ES/PT/EN HTML, media, links, CSS or frozen content. No changes to production without review.

scope.integration_blocker: pix-data JSON provides runtime ES/PT/EN content. The FR preview builder removes scripts; must render static translated content in private FR preview or extend private renderer without changing source pages.

scope.editorial_review: recheck visa and minor-travel rules against current official authorities prior to publishing
medical recommendations and destination-specific entry requirements should be verified against current official sources prior to publishing
recheck current consular addresses and duty contacts before publishing
check current Pier Mauá operational notices and VLT routing prior to publishing
check accessibility status, reduced-mobility access and transit fare eligibility before publishing
check insurance disclosures, external affiliate links, emergency care accuracy and the assistance phone number before publishing

scope.coverage: ES HTML visible, title/description, embedded stay-data arrays (5 areas, intro, UI) translated and checked
scope.integration_blocker: All areas live in JSON script, current private FR preview strips scripts. Must pre-render translated French content in private preview, without changing approved ES/PT/EN source.

scope.coverage: ES HTML intro and title, luggage-content.js metadata, 12 sections and 6 FAQs, luggage-page.js UI labels and flow steps
scope.integration_blocker: Content rendered from JS modules. Private FR preview strips scripts and must render all translated sections. Source uses 3 language-specific graphic photos; FR-specific graphics must be reviewed or prepared before release. Preserve Bounce links/affiliate disclosure and avoid editing approved assets.

coverage_test: Exact Spanish dictionary keys verified against 16 source pages or their dynamically generated content where applicable, including visible text, title/description/social metadata, alt/aria labels. Dynamic Pix, stay-data and luggage-content/page strings included in FR staging dictionaries. The 16 FR pages have not been built, visually inspected, integrated or published; checker coverage is not a production QA guarantee.
remaining_validation: Recheck source SHA before merging, since upstream content may change.
Compare each translation with Spanish meaning and any original PT-BR/EN version.
Merge dictionaries into PR24 private FR pilot without overwriting its current translations.
Add FR preview routes only when renderer supports them; verify text, images, links, JSON-LD, noindex, 1440px / 390px.
Run frozen-content guard, build QA and sitemap compare. Do not publish FR before approved.
Verify dynamic/embedded content outside the tested text surfaces and review medical/migration/consular factual currency.
Validate accessibility, health guidance, consular and airport/terminal operational facts on publication date.
For `/guia/donde-alojarse/`, render all 5 neighborhood cards, introductions, UI text and photos in private FR preview without touching approved source scripts.
For `/guia/guarda-equipaje/`, render 12 content sections and 6 FAQs and check Bounce disclosure and 3 image artworks with Spanish/Portuguese/English typography before FR publication.
